rules.title: RSO Allowable Annual Rent Increase
rules.citation: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (LAMC § 151 et seq.)
rules.quote: Rent may be increased once every 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage (click here to view the allowable rent increase PDF). Effective February 2, 2026, the landlord can no longer include an additional percentage increase for utilities.
rules.summary: Landlords may increase rent once every 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage, and as of February 2, 2026, cannot add an additional percentage for utilities.
rules.key_value: Annual percentage (formula not specified in text)
rules.coverage_text: rental properties that were first built on or before October 1, 1978
rules.exemption_note: Condominiums and townhomes - Rent amount is not regulated for tenancies that commenced after December 31, 1995

rules.title: RSO Additional Tenant Rent Increase
rules.citation: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (LAMC § 151 et seq.)
rules.quote: Effective February 2, 2026, an additonal 10% increase for an additional dependent added to the tenancy is no longer permitted. However, a 10% for an additional tenant is allowed (not a dependent) if moves into a rental unit: Landlords can increase the rent within 60 days of learning about the additional tenant.
rules.summary: As of February 2, 2026, landlords may increase rent by 10% when an additional tenant (not a dependent) moves into a rental unit, with the increase allowed within 60 days of learning about the additional tenant.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Effective February 2, 2026, an additonal 10% increase for an additional dependent added to the tenancy is no longer permitted.
rules.coverage_text: rental properties that were first built on or before October 1, 1978

rules.title: RSO Just Cause for Eviction - At-Fault
rules.citation: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (LAMC § 151 et seq.)
rules.quote: Tenant is at-fault Failure to pay rent Failure to fix or address a violation of the rental agreement Creating a nuisance or causing damage to the rental unit Using the rental unit for an illegal purpose Failure to renew a similar rental agreement Failure to provide the landlord with reasonable access to the rental unit The person at the end of the lease term is a subtenant not approved by the landlord
rules.summary: Landlords may evict tenants for at-fault reasons including failure to pay rent, violations of the rental agreement, creating a nuisance or damage, illegal use, failure to renew a similar lease, denying reasonable access, or unauthorized subtenants.
rules.coverage_text: rental properties that were first built on or before October 1, 1978

rules.title: RSO Just Cause for Eviction - No-Fault
rules.citation: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (LAMC § 151 et seq.)
rules.quote: Tenant is not at-fault The owner or immediate family member will move into the rental unit A resident manager will move into the rental unit Demolition and permanent removal from the rental market Government order Conversion to affordable housing
rules.summary: Landlords may evict tenants for no-fault reasons including owner or family move-in, resident manager move-in, demolition and removal from rental market, government order, or conversion to affordable housing.
rules.coverage_text: rental properties that were first built on or before October 1, 1978

rules.title: RSO Eviction Notice Filing Requirement
rules.quote: All notices to terminate a tenancy for all rental units subject to City's Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) must be filed with the Los Angeles Housing Department (LAHD) within three (3) business days of service on the tenant per Los Angeles Municipal Code 151.09.C.9 & 165.05.B.5.
rules.summary: Landlords must file all notices to terminate a tenancy with the Los Angeles Housing Department within three business days of serving the tenant.
rules.coverage_text: rental properties that were first built on or before October 1, 1978

rules.title: RSO No-Fault Eviction Relocation Assistance
rules.citation: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (LAMC § 151 et seq.)
rules.quote: No-fault evictions require the payment of relocation assistance.
rules.summary: Landlords must pay relocation assistance to tenants for no-fault evictions.
rules.coverage_text: rental properties that were first built on or before October 1, 1978

rules.title: RSO Interest Payments on Security Deposits
rules.citation: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (LAMC § 151 et seq.)
rules.summary: Landlords must pay interest on security deposits for RSO-covered rental units.
rules.coverage_text: rental properties that were first built on or before October 1, 1978
